name: rankrat
description: Self-hosted SEO intelligence over Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, PageSpeed, CrUX, Cloudflare, IndexNow, and optional local Lighthouse — persistent monitoring, internal-link and content opportunities, ownership, remediation, and multi-provider backlinks. Read-only and boundary-limited by default. MCP over stdio and Streamable HTTP, plus REST.

interface.longDescription: Audit and monitor owned sites, inspect search and analytics evidence, and apply bounded SEO remediation through Rankrat's MCP and REST transports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Rankrat to inspect the configured site's current SEO state, explain the evidence, and propose only boundary-safe actions.
